_comment: The episode catalogue. One source of truth, read by both the Hub section and the weekly email job, so a title or link is never written down twice. Hand-maintained: add an entry when an episode publishes. `videoUrl` is the SharePoint item URL and stays empty until the file is uploaded -- the email job refuses to send an episode whose videoUrl is empty rather than mailing a dead link.

series.name: Two-Minute Training Tuesday
series.tagline: One tip. One video. Under two minutes. Every Tuesday.

sender._comment: Display name over an address Josh owns -- legitimate, and no Send As grant needed. Switching the address to the Mr. Bean finance alias later DOES need Send As on that mailbox; see distribution/admin-setup.md. Never put the Mr. Bean display name over this address -- that is the spoofing shape that renders as 'on behalf of' and can fail DMARC.

sharePoint._comment: INTERIM home, pending access to CLC Training. NOTE ON LINKS: this site is a PRIVATE M365 group site -- Visitors is empty and Members holds one person -- so a path-based URL only opens for someone who already has site access, which nobody else does. videoUrl must therefore be the 'anyone in the organisation with the link' share URL (the :v:/s/... form with the ?e= token that SharePoint's Copy link produces). A path-based link was tried first and broke the moment the mail was forwarded. The durable fix is to grant the library read to all staff, or to move to CLC Training where all-staff read already exists; until then, share links are load-bearing and must not be 'tidied' into path URLs.

episodes.title: Stop copying and pasting to get a unique list
episodes.summary: Three functions replace the copy-paste-dedupe-sort routine on any export: =UNIQUE(range), =SORT(UNIQUE(range)), and =FILTER(table, column = criteria).

episodes.title: Data Validation, the basic way and the way that maintains itself
episodes.summary: Every drop-down in Excel is Data Validation. Point Source at a range and it goes stale; point it at =$O$5# and the list maintains itself.
